basic_profile.bio: Hello! I'm Alex, a 28-year-old travel enthusiast based in Slovenia. I recently discovered my love for road trips and tiny living, which led to an obsession with teardrop trailers. Professionally, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore new places. When I'm not working or traveling, I enjoy dabbling in digital art and occasionally attempt to improve my handyman skills. I'm single and enjoy my solo adventures, but I'm open to meeting like-minded travelers. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, especially after a day of work or on weekends when I'm planning my next trip.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, having earned my degree from a local university in Slovenia. My interest in travel and tiny living is mostly self-taught, fueled by online communities and YouTube channels dedicated to camper life and DIY projects. Recently, I've been exploring financial independence strategies through online forums.
